statement: Every section conjugacy class of the finite intrinsic Heisenberg quotient fromE31 overK=Q(zeta3) is parametrized: for an intrinsic abelian pair(a,b), putA=zeta3*a. The fiber is nonempty exactly when X^3+A Y^3+A^2 Z^3-3AXYZ=b has a solution inK, and every nonempty fiber is a torsor underK*/(K*^3<A,b>). All dependent cases and an explicit order27 Galois construction from each independent norm solution are included. The fiber group is explicitly a direct sum of F3 in the zeta-unit and Eisenstein-prime valuation coordinates, with zero, one or two row-reduced pivot coordinates removed.
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d); section51.16, folios733v-736v, scans172-178, (371)-(379), through the additional intrinsic morphismE31.4.
notes: The arithmetic group is explicitly identified with H3xG_K by(n,g)->(nq_g,g), q_g=(kappa3(zeta)(g),0,0), so the nontrivial affine shift is retained. The cup obstruction is identified with the exact cyclic-algebra factor set via the cochain beta^{u_g}; the split/norm equivalence is proved by the representation U=w*sigma. For independent A,b the norm solution gives gamma^3=w^2sigma(w), sigma(gamma)=beta*gamma/w, tau(gamma)=gamma, an actual order27 Galois extension. Conjugation adds exactly r*kappa(b)-s*kappa(A), proving the full fiber quotient. This is a complete classification of the specified finite quotient overK and does not identify it with the full intrinsic rank10 problem. The norm-Euclidean proof for Z[zeta] and exact unique-factorization isomorphism K*/K*^3 to F3[zeta] plus the direct sum over nonzero prime ideals are included. Gaussian elimination gives exact coordinates for every conjugacy quotient.
